_meta.title: huiying Canonical Product Dataset
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the huiying main site product pages (huiying brand + congben catalog).

categories.name: Air Filter
categories.desc: Engine air filters that remove dust and suspended particles from intake air before it reaches the combustion chamber, reducing cylinder, piston and piston-ring wear.

categories.name: Cabin Filter
categories.desc: Cabin air filters that capture dust, pollen and particulate from outside air before it enters the passenger cabin.

categories.name: Oil Filter
categories.desc: Engine oil filters that remove contaminants and carbon sludge from circulating engine oil, protecting lubrication components and extending oil life.

categories.name: Fuel Filter
categories.desc: Fuel filters that remove iron oxide, dust and other impurities from fuel to prevent fuel-system blockage and reduce mechanical wear.

categories.name: Wiper
categories.desc: Wiper blades and related wiper products for clear visibility.

categories.name: Brake Pads
categories.desc: Ceramic and semi-metallic brake pads for passenger cars, matched by OE number.

categories.name: Spark Plugs
categories.desc: Ignition spark plugs for gasoline engines, matched by OE and engine application.

categories.name: Rubber Hoses
categories.desc: EPDM, NBR and silicone hoses for cooling, fuel and air-transfer circuits, custom and OE-matched.

products.name: Oil Filter
products.desc: Spin-on engine oil filter for the passenger and light-commercial service market. Its media traps wear metal and carbon sludge before either can reach the oil pump, journals or bearing shells, and it is replaced at every oil service as a matter of course.

products.name: Cabin Filter
products.desc: Cabin air filter that sits between the outside intake and the passenger compartment, holding back dust, pollen and road particulate before they reach occupants or the blower. Frame fit and any activated-carbon option are matched to the model rather than guessed.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Panel-type engine air filter that keeps abrasive dust out of the combustion chamber, protecting pistons, rings and bores from the wear that shortens engine life. Element dimensions, pleat count and the seal design are confirmed by OE or cross-reference before quoting.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter positioned for intake-air cleanliness across a wide passenger fleet. Because a near-match by eye is not a match, we confirm the element geometry and media specification against the air-cleaner housing rather than relying on appearance.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter that protects the intake side from airborne dust and suspended particulate. The element is confirmed by OE or cross-reference against the housing dimensions and the required media area, so airflow and filtration stay in balance.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Intake air filter for passenger and light-commercial applications where bore and ring wear are the dominant service risk. We match the panel or cylindrical dimensions and the seal style per application instead of judging by outer size alone.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter engineered for the intake system, removing airborne dust before it can reach the combustion chamber. Pleat count, seal type and media area are matched by OE or cross-reference number, not by a photograph.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Intake air filter that is the foundation of cylinder and piston-ring longevity in the engine bay. The element is confirmed against the air-cleaner housing dimensions and media area so it seals correctly and passes the designed airflow.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter for passenger and commercial intake systems, keeping dust and suspended particles out of the combustion chamber. We confirm geometry and media specification per application and treat pleat consistency as the quality signal.

products.name: Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter specified for intake-side protection, limiting cylinder and piston-ring wear caused by abrasive dust. The element is matched by OE or cross-reference to the housing, pleat count and seal so it drops in correctly the first time.

products.name: Toyota Oil Filter 90915YZZE1
products.desc: Toyota-pattern spin-on oil filter listed for the RAV4, Camry, Corolla and Prius family, matched to OE 90915-YZZE1 / 90915-YZZJ1 with a High-Density Filtration Media build. Thread, seal diameter and bypass calibration are confirmed against the OE application before quoting.

products.name: 500FGFH Diesel Fuel Water Separator
products.desc: Diesel fuel water separator matched to OE 500FH / 500FG. It removes particulate and free water before either reaches the injectors and high-pressure pump, with the filtration rating and water-separation capability the procurement checks for common-rail protection.

products.name: NBR Nitrile Rubber Hose and
products.desc: Nitrile butadiene (NBR/Buna-N) rubber hose for oil and fuel transfer circuits. The compound's oil resistance is the reason to choose it over EPDM, and reinforcement plus inner diameter are confirmed per application.

products.name: 1780130070 Car Air Intake Filter and
products.desc: Toyota-pattern engine air filter matched to OE 17801-30070 (cross-reference 1780130070), built with PP and non-woven fabric. The element removes dust and sand from intake air, with pleat spacing and media area matched to the air-cleaner housing for the designed airflow.

products.name: Car Engine Air Filter 1780121050 Toyota Corolla
products.desc: Toyota Corolla, Avensis and Auris engine air filter matched to OE 17801-21050 (cross-reference 17801-0M020, 17801-0T020, 17801-0T030), built with non-woven fabric. Housing dimensions and seal design are confirmed so the element drops in and seals around the lip.

products.name: LF14000NN Heavy Duty Truck Engine Oil Filter
products.desc: Heavy-duty truck oil filter matched to OE LF14000NN for extended oil-drain fleets. The canister, media and bypass-valve setting are the service-grade details that separate it from a look-alike, and they are confirmed per application.

products.name: of Honda Engine Oil Filter 15400PLC004 15400PLC003
products.desc: Honda engine oil filter matched to OE 15400-PLC-004 / 15400-PLC-003 (cross-reference 15400-PLM-A02, 15400-RTA-003, 15400-PH1-003 and others). Spin-on fitment, media efficiency and the anti-drain-back behaviour are confirmed against the Honda application.

products.name: Diesel Fuel Filter FF5507
products.desc: Diesel fuel filter matched to OE FF5507. It removes particulate upstream of the injectors and high-pressure pump, where a tight filtration rating is what protects common-rail hardware from abrasive wear.

products.name: Truck Engine Air Filter P320510 0342776010
products.desc: Freightliner Cascadia / Detroit Diesel truck air filter matched to OE 03-42776-010 / 0342776010 (cross-reference P320510 / 91559 / 997879). Dust-holding capacity and pleat consistency matter most on a commercial intake, so media area is matched per application.

products.name: EPDM Upper Radiator Hose 17127525023 BMW Parts
products.desc: BMW upper radiator hose matched to OE 17127525023 in high-grade EPDM for coolant service. EPDM's water-and-glycol resistance is what suits it to the radiator circuit, with diameter and elbow geometry confirmed against the OE number.

products.name: RE596317 Air Filter John Deere ESeries
products.desc: John Deere E-series air filter matched to OE RE596317 / RE596318. In agricultural duty the element faces heavy dust, so pleat spacing and dust-holding capacity are the quality signals we confirm against the application.

products.name: Ceramic Front Brake Pads 044650K070 Toyota
products.desc: Ceramic front brake pads matched to OE 04465-04030 / 04465-0K020 for Toyota platforms. Friction formulation, backing-plate fit and the completeness of the noise/hardware kit determine pedal feel, disc life and return rate, so set contents are confirmed per application.

products.name: of 3533008010 Automatic Transmission Oil Filter Toyota
products.desc: Automatic-transmission oil filter listed for Toyota and Lexus, matched to OE 35330-08010. Because it lives inside the transmission pan rather than on the block, the filter's pickup geometry and seal seating are confirmed per application.

products.name: 04E129620 Air Intake Filter VW of Car Filters
products.desc: VW air intake filter matched to OE 04E129620 / L04E129620D, built with PU and filter paper. The PU frame seals against the airbox and the paper pleats do the filtering, with dimensions and seal confirmed against the Volkswagen application.

products.name: Car Air Filter 16546ED000 16546ED500 Nissan Tiida NV200
products.desc: Nissan Tiida, NV200 and March air filter matched to OE 16546-ED000 (cross-reference 16546-ED500), built with PU and high-grade filter paper. Element geometry and seal are confirmed so the filter fits the Nissan airbox without bypass.

products.name: 1500A098 1500A358 Engine Air Filter Mitsubishi
products.desc: Mitsubishi engine air filter matched to OE 1500A098 (cross-reference 1500A358), built with PP and non-woven fabric. Pleat count and media area are matched to the Mitsubishi air-cleaner housing for the designed airflow.

products.name: 172205R0008 Air Filter Honda
products.desc: Honda air filter matched to OE 17220-5R0-008 (cross-reference 17220-5RO-008), built with PP and non-woven fabric. The element is confirmed against the Honda airbox dimensions and seal so it seals correctly and passes the designed airflow.

products.name: 281132S000 Engine Air Filter KIA HYUNDAI
products.desc: Kia / Hyundai engine air filter matched to OE 28113-2S000, built with PP, non-woven fabric and cellulose, at 259 × 164 × 54.5 mm. The cellulose blend trades on dust capacity, with dimensions confirmed per the application.

products.name: A2700940004 Auto Air Filter Mercedes Benz
products.desc: Mercedes-Benz A / B / CLA / GLA air filter matched to OE A2700940004 (cross-reference MANN C27004 / BOSCH F026400380), built with PU and filter paper. The PU frame seals the airbox and the pleated paper does the filtering, confirmed per application.

products.name: Engine Air Filter 13717811026 BMW X3 X5 X6
products.desc: BMW X3 / X5 / X6 engine air filter matched to OE 13717811026 (cross-reference MANN C36014 / BOSCH F026400366), built with PP and non-woven fabric for the N55 / N57 / N20 engines. Dimensions and seal are confirmed against the BMW airbox.

products.name: HighFlow Engine Air Filter LR011593 LR161843 Land Rover
products.desc: Land Rover Discovery 4, Range Rover Sport and Range Rover air filter matched to OE LR011593 (cross-reference LR161843), built with PU and premium filter paper. The PU frame and pleat area are confirmed against the Land Rover housing for a drop-in fit.

products.name: 90915YZZE2 Oil Filter Toyota and Lexus
products.desc: Toyota/Lexus spin-on oil filter matched to OE 90915-YZZE2 / 90915-YZZJ2, listed across Camry, Corolla, RAV4, Highlander, Yaris, Prius, Matrix and several Lexus models. The wide cross-reference makes correct thread and seal confirmation the first ordering check.

products.name: Mercedes Benz Engine Oil Filter A0001802309 A0001802609
products.desc: Mercedes-Benz engine oil filter matched to OE A0001802309 / A0001802609, built with a Pressure-Resistant Heavy-Duty media. Cartridge or spin-on form and the bypass specification are confirmed against the Mercedes application before quoting.

products.name: Mercedes Benz Oil Filter A2701800009 A2701800109
products.desc: Mercedes-Benz M270 / M274 engine oil filter matched to OE A2701800009 / A2701800109 / A2701840025 / A2701840125, with a Pressure-Resistant Heavy-Duty Steel build. Burst rating and bypass setting are the procurement checks for these long-interval engines.

products.name: Oil Filter 0415237010 04152YZZA6 Toyota Corolla
products.desc: Toyota Corolla oil filter matched to OE 04152-37010 / 04152-YZZA6. Spin-on thread and seal are confirmed against the Corolla family, with media and bypass specification as the deciding quality points.

products.name: Oil Filter 0415231080 04152YZZA5
products.desc: Toyota/Lexus oil filter matched to OE 04152-31080 (cross-reference 04152-38010, 04152-31060, 04152-0P010), built with High-density premium filter paper and listed for the 2.5L–3.5L engine band. Thread, seal and bypass are confirmed per engine.

products.name: Ceramic Front Brake Pads 04465-0K020 04465-04030 04465-
products.desc: Ceramic front brake pads matched to OE 04465-0K020 / 04465-04030 / 04465-0K070 for Toyota. The friction material and the included shims, springs and anti-rattle clips are confirmed per application, since a pad that ships without its hardware kit generates returns.

products.name: Truck Engine Air Filter P320510 03-42776-010 91559 0342
products.desc: Truck engine air filter matched to OE P320510 (cross-reference 03-42776-010 / 91559 / 0342776010 / 997879). On a commercial intake, dust-holding capacity and pleat consistency are the deciding quality points, confirmed per application.

products.name: Auto Engine Oil Filters 15400-PLC-004 15400-PLC-003 HON
products.desc: Honda oil filter matched to OE 15400-PLC, the shared-platform Honda service number. Media efficiency, spin-on thread and the anti-drain-back valve are confirmed against the Honda application rather than assumed from a photo.

products.name: Auto Engine Oil Filter 04152-31090 04152-YZZA1 Oil Filt
products.desc: Toyota oil filter matched to OE 04152-31090 / 04152-YZZA1. Correct thread pitch, seal diameter and bypass-valve calibration are what keep this filter service-grade, and they are confirmed per application before quoting.

products.name: Oil Water Separator Assembly 900FG/900FH Fuel Water Sep
products.desc: Oil-water separator assembly matched to OE 900FG / 900FH. Water separation is the headline feature — free water in diesel corrodes and wears injectors, so the separator's rating and drain arrangement are confirmed per application.

products.name: High Efficiency Diesel Fuel Filter Water Separator 1000
products.desc: High-efficiency diesel fuel filter water separator matched to OE 1000FH / 1000FG. Particulate and free-water removal are confirmed against the common-rail application, where injector protection is the entire point of the part.

products.name: Auto Engine Oil Filters 15208-65F00 15208-65f0a cars au
products.desc: Suzuki-pattern engine oil filter matched to OE 15208-65F00. Spin-on fitment and the bypass specification are confirmed against the Suzuki application, with media quality treated as the main differentiator.

products.name: Fuel filter 23390-0L070 23390-0L090 Toyota
products.desc: Toyota fuel filter matched to OE 23390-0L070 / 23390-0L090. The filter removes particulate before fuel reaches the injectors and pump, with fitting style and micron rating confirmed against the Toyota application.

products.name: Car Cabin Filter AC Air Conditioning Filter 87139-0N010
products.desc: Toyota cabin air filter matched to OE 87139-0N010 / 87139-30040. It traps dust, pollen and particulate before outside air reaches the cabin, with edge-seal fit and any carbon option confirmed per model year.

products.name: Motorcycle Fuel and Oil Filters
products.desc: Motorcycle oil and fuel filter line built with High-Grade Filter Paper and PP, positioned for the small-engine and two-wheeler aftermarket. Thread, seal and media rating are confirmed per application because motorcycle filters carry tight space and flow constraints.

products.name: Reinforced Silicone Turbo Heater Hose
products.desc: Reinforced silicone turbo and heater hose in Premium Silicone. Silicone holds its shape at higher heat than EPDM, and the reinforcement lets it hold pressure and vacuum without collapsing — compound, reinforcement and bore are confirmed per application.

products.name: Braided Silicone Heater Vacuum Hose
products.desc: Braided silicone heater and vacuum hose, available in Silicone, EPDM and NBR. The braided reinforcement resists collapse under vacuum, which is what a heater or vacuum line needs; compound and inner diameter are confirmed per circuit.

products.name: EPDM Rubber Elbow Hose and
products.desc: EPDM rubber elbow hose in premium EPDM for coolant and air circuits. EPDM resists water, glycol and heat ageing, and the elbow form is supplied to the bend angle the circuit requires — compound, reinforcement and bore are confirmed per application.

products.name: Oil Resistant NBR Automotive Fuel Hose and
products.desc: Oil-resistant NBR automotive fuel hose, available in NBR, Silicone and EPDM. NBR's oil and fuel resistance is what makes it the fuel-line choice, with reinforcement and inner diameter confirmed per application.

products.name: High Temperature Radiator Silicone Hose in
products.desc: High-temperature radiator silicone hose in Premium Silicone Rubber. Silicone tolerates the heat cycling of a radiator circuit better than EPDM, and the hose is supplied straight, as 45°/90° elbows or a 180° U-bend to match the layout.

products.name: Black Hydraulic Oil Fuel Hose High Pressure Fuel Line N
products.desc: Black hydraulic, oil and fuel hose for high-pressure fuel line duty. Compound, reinforcement and inner diameter are confirmed per application, because a hose that hardens or swells under oil is a premature-failure risk on the end vehicle.

products.name: High Temp Radiator Hose Auto Elbow Silicone Hose Pipe c
products.desc: High-temperature radiator hose in auto-elbow silicone for car cooling circuits. The silicone compound holds up to the heat of the cooling loop, and the elbow geometry is supplied to the routing the vehicle requires.

products.name: Oil Resistant NBR Automotive Fuel Hose
products.desc: Oil-resistant NBR automotive fuel hose. NBR's resistance to oil and fuel is the reason it is the fuel-line compound, and reinforcement plus inner diameter are confirmed against the application before quoting.

products.name: Auto Black Elbow EPDM Rubber Hose Pipe Coolant Elbow Ra
products.desc: Auto black elbow EPDM rubber hose for coolant elbow and radiator pipe circuits. EPDM's glycol resistance suits the coolant loop, and the elbow bend is matched to the engine bay routing per application.

products.name: Heat Resistant Braided Silicone Heater & Vacuum Hose
products.desc: Heat-resistant braided silicone heater and vacuum hose. The silicone compound tolerates under-bonnet heat and the braid resists vacuum collapse, which together make it the heater-line and vacuum-line choice.

products.name: Reinforced Silicone Turbo & Heater Hose (90 Degree)
products.desc: Reinforced silicone turbo and heater hose in a 90-degree elbow form. The reinforcement holds pressure and vacuum, silicone holds heat, and the 90° bend matches the turbo-to-intercooler or heater routing per application.

products.name: Motorcycle Oil Gasoline Filter Fuel Filters
products.desc: Motorcycle oil and gasoline filter for the small-engine service market. Compact canister dimensions and flow rate matter more here than on a car, so thread, seal and media are confirmed per application.

products.name: Auto Engine Spark Plug
products.desc: Gasoline engine spark plug for the ignition aftermarket. Heat range, thread reach and electrode gap are the three details that must match the engine, so the exact application is confirmed per model before ordering.

products.name: Diesel Fuel Filter Water Separator
products.desc: Diesel fuel filter water separator for the common-rail aftermarket. Particulate and free-water removal are confirmed per application — the filtration rating and drain arrangement protect injectors and the high-pressure pump from premature wear.

products.name: Heavy Duty Trucks Oil Filters
products.desc: Heavy-duty truck oil filter for extended-drain commercial fleets. Canister integrity, media capacity and bypass-valve setting are confirmed per application, since a truck filter runs far longer between services than a passenger filter.
